subject: Subprocessor snapshot request for PCI scope and cross-border details
messages:
From: Margaret Liu <margaret.liu@fintegral.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, security@fintegral.com
Date: Thu, 30 May 2029 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: subprocessor snapshot for PCI scope

Hi Connor / Laura,

We're doing a quick PCI scoping exercise and need a short, customer-facing snapshot of the current subprocessor roster and any cross-border data movements that could touch cardholder data. Can you provide the following by end of day: 

- A one-page list of subprocessors in-scope for our account (role, country, and purpose)
- Any processors that have temporary or transient access (and the duration/purpose)
- KMS/HSM jurisdiction for key management providers
- Any redaction options if we need to hide internal hostnames or IPs

Attached is our scope_request_template.xlsx — fill the tab labeled "customer_snapshot" if convenient. If you need an NDA amendment or DPA addendum, please flag and we can route to procurement.

Thanks,
Margaret Liu
Sr. Security Program Manager
Fintegral
attachments: scope_request_template.xlsx (XLSX)
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Margaret Liu <margaret.liu@fintegral.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 30 May 2029 10:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: subprocessor snapshot for PCI scope

Hi Margaret — thanks for the clear ask. We'll take this on. Quick plan: 

- Kimberly will run the roster export and produce a redacted CSV and one-page summary for you (customer_snapshot tab).
- I'll validate KMS/HSM jurisdiction and confirm any transient accesses.
- If we identify any subprocessors requiring a DPA addendum, I'll include DocuSign links and estimated SLAs for turn-around.

Timeline: aiming to send the customer_snapshot and roster export by 4pm PT today, or earlier if we have follow-ups.

Laura — can you and Kim confirm the export and any known temporary-access agents?

Connor O'Brien
Head, Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 30 May 2029 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Subprocessor roster export and cross-border map (draft)

Connor / Laura — attaching the export and a quick cross-border diagram. Highlights from the export: 

- KeyVaultCo (US) — KMS provider, keys in us-east-1 (full encryption keys, no remote key sharing).
- ObjectStore (US/EU) — primary object store in us-west-2, EU mirror for residency customers (data-at-rest encrypted).
- EdgeProbe (SG) — telemetry and connection metadata only, transient access for routing/observability (service account access: 2029-05-15 to 2029-08-15). No cardholder data stored or processed.
- LogRelay (EU) — logs for observability, pseudonymized request IDs only; contractual DPA covers EU processing.

Attachments included as stubs (see below). For redaction: we can provide hostnames as hostname-redacted.example and truncate IPs to /24. Let me know how much detail Fintegral wants.

Attachments: subprocessor_roster_20290530.csv (CSV), crossborder_map_20290530.png (PNG)

If Margaret needs a DocuSign DPA addendum, we have a template; Connor, I can pre-fill and send the DocuSign link once you confirm.

Kimberly Park
Vendor Compliance Analyst
Redwood Inference
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Margaret Liu <margaret.liu@fintegral.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 30 May 2029 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: subprocessor snapshot for PCI scope

Hi Margaret — quick update and the customer snapshot below. See attached CSV/diagram in the shared Drive (link included). If anything needs more detail we can jump on a 20-minute call tomorrow.

Customer-facing snapshot (short):
- KeyVaultCo (US) — KMS/HSM provider; keys stored in us-east-1; used for envelope key operations.
- ObjectStore (US/EU) — object storage for application artifacts; EU mirror used only when customer chooses EU residency.
- EdgeProbe (Singapore) — limited telemetry/observability only; temporary access for routing (May–Aug 2029). No cardholder data.
- LogRelay (Germany) — pseudonymized logs for telemetry; contractual safeguards in place.

Redaction options provided: hostnames redacted to "hostname-redacted.example" and IPs truncated to /24 in the CSV.

Links and attachments: 
- Roster export & summary (CSV): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-example
- DPA addendum (DocuSign) if required: https://app.docusign.com/mention/example-id-12345

Next steps / asks:
- Margaret: confirm whether you need the unredacted CSV for PCI evidence or if the redacted export suffices for your scoping exercise.
- If unredacted is required, we'll request written justification and route via legal (expected 48–72 hours turnaround).

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Connor O'Brien
Head, Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference
attachments: subprocessor_roster_20290530.csv (CSV), crossborder_map_20290530.png (PNG)
